Planning in Accrington

Accrington Town Centre and Christ Church

Hyndburn Borough Council lists two conservation areas in Accrington: Accrington Town Centre and Christ Church. It has adopted an appraisal and management plan for the town centre one, and its online map shows where each boundary runs.

The council says a conservation area recognises the wider place around its historic buildings, including the street pattern, characteristic materials, scale and styles. If your house is inside one and you want to change the look of the roof, speak to the council's planners before work starts.

Source: Hyndburn Borough Council: conservation areas
